svg.title: CASTÚO-SYSTEM — governed orchestration: field data rises, decisions descend, evidence anchors
svg.desc: Concept illustration; optional motion is illustrative only. Left: field data from six sources rises through root-like branches, passes identity, provenance, integrity, permission and quality controls, and reaches a vector-traced brain from the owner-provided LinkedIn reference. Right, as a simulation: outputs descend through three policy gates with grounding thresholds 0.18, 0.36 and 0.52; items below threshold abstain and leave a trace; the rest enter a simulated review queue released by a timed rule every 14 steps with no human actor modelled, and become synthetic events anchored in a synthetic territory and chained with SHA-256. No live data, field validation, production use or autonomous decisions are claimed.
svg.text: timed release every 14 steps · no human actor modelled
offline → pending → reconciled · evidence reaches the accountable owner — not an automatic action
Field data rises. Decisions descend. Evidence anchors.
